Strategy: Give +30 to the third-tightest feasible bin, skipping the two tightest to preserve them for future items, with Best Fit ordering elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    second = min([x for x in bins if x > mn]) if len([x for x in bins if x > mn]) > 0 else mn
    third = min([x for x in bins if x > second]) if len([x for x in bins if x > second]) > 0 else second
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r == third else 0) for r in bins]
```
